unknown_beacon_like_behavior.trust_reason: Observed repeated external connections without parent process. Behavior resembles slow beaconing.

orphan_process_exec.trust_reason: Process executed with no valid parent (PPID = 0 or missing). Indicates anomaly or evasion.

excessive_child_processes.trust_reason: Process spawned unusually high number of child processes in short time. Could indicate fork bomb or script loop.

unknown_file_modification_burst.trust_reason: High volume of writes to system or user directory with high entropy files. Potential ransomware or staging.

unsigned_network_script.trust_reason: Unsigned script initiated network connection. No known semantic match, but high-risk behavior pattern.
